metric.subscriptionsActiveOffer: Active subscriptions on a paid offer
note.appleCountsNotUnique: These are counts of events. Unique users cannot be added up across rows.
note.appleEstimates: Sales and Trends figures are next-day estimates.
note.appleImpressionsOnlyViaReports: Impressions and product page views exist only in the Analytics Reports, which need a report request or an imported file.
note.appleInAppNotIncluded: Only the app itself is counted here, not in-app purchases (UNVERIFIED mapping of product types).
note.applePacificTime: Apple sales days run on Pacific Time.
note.applePrivacyThresholds: Apple drops rows with very few users and adds small random noise to detailed reports.
note.appleProceedsPerCurrency: Proceeds are in the payout currency of each row. They are shown per currency and never converted.
note.appleProductSalesIncludeInApp: Sales by product include in-app purchases and subscriptions of the app (UNVERIFIED matching by SKU). The total chart counts only the app itself, so products can add up to more than the total.
note.appleRatingHistoryNotAvailable: Apple offers no rating history through its API, so there is no rating chart for the App Store.
note.appleSubscriptionCounts: These count subscriptions on the day, not people: one person with two subscriptions counts twice. Active figures are the day’s snapshot, so a week or a month shows their average.
note.appleSubscriptionEvents: New, cancelled and trial conversions are classified from the event names in Apple’s Subscription Event report (UNVERIFIED for events Apple adds later); other events are not counted.
note.appleUsageOptInOnly: Apple usage data (sessions, crashes) covers only users who chose to share data with developers.
note.appleUsageSampleNotTotal: This is a sample of your users, not a total.
note.derived: Derived from other series; it may not match the number the store console shows.
note.gaps: Some days in this range have no data.
note.googleLegacyStoreListing: These come from the legacy Play Console export. Google changed its store listing metrics in 2026 and may no longer fill them (UNVERIFIED).
note.googleMonthlyFiles: Google posts these reports as monthly files, usually 3 to 7 days late.
note.googleNoImpressions: Google Play offers no impressions in any API or export.
note.googleRatingAverageOnly: Only the average rating is available, not the number of ratings.
note.googleUnitUnverified: Whether Google reports this rate as a fraction or a percentage is not confirmed (UNVERIFIED); the value is shown as the API sent it.
note.imported: Some days come from a file that was imported, not from the store API.
note.noDataYet: No data has been read yet.
note.onlySinceConnected: History starts when this server first read the source.
note.playEarningsMonthly: Google Play earnings are one figure per calendar month, posted about the 5th of the next month. They are drawn per month, on the first day of it, never per day.
note.playEarningsNet: Net is the sum of every line Google lists for this app in its monthly Earnings report (charges, taxes, Google fees, refunds, adjustments), exactly as Google signs the amounts. It is the report for accounting, not an estimate.
note.playEarningsPacific: Google assigns the lines of the Earnings report to months on Pacific Time, which can differ from the UTC days of the estimated sales.
note.playEarningsPerCurrency: Amounts are in the merchant currency of each line (the currency you are paid in). They are shown per currency and never converted or added together.
note.playEstimatedSalesGross: Google Play estimated sales are what buyers paid, taxes included and before Google deducts its fee. They are not your proceeds and not meant for accounting (the monthly Earnings report is).
note.playSalesLatency: Google adds charged and refunded orders to the month file every day, up to a few days late. Recent days and refunds can still change.
note.playSalesPerCurrency: Amounts are in the currency the buyer paid in (Currency of Sale). They are shown per currency and never converted.
note.playSalesUtc: Google Play sales days run on UTC.
note.playSubscriptionStats: Google’s subscription statistics: whether Active includes free trials or the grace period is not stated (UNVERIFIED). They need the Play Console permission View financial data.
note.recentDaysIncomplete: The newest days can still change while the store completes them.
note.salesProductsCapped: Only the first 200 products of the app are kept. Sales of further products are not stored.
note.sourceNotConnected: This source is not connected yet.
note.unknown: A limit of the store data applies here.

With the Play Console permission View financial data it also reads estimated sales (what buyers paid, not your proceeds), monthly earnings (net of Google's fees and taxes) and subscription statistics.
off.tipKeeps: It keeps them on this server and shows where each number comes from, how late it can be and what it leaves out. Nothing is requested from a store until it is turned on.

playSetup.step1: In Play Console open Download reports, then Statistics, and press Copy Cloud Storage URI next to the section header. It starts with gs://pubsite_prod_rev_ and is the same for every app of your Play account.
playSetup.step2: Give the service account of this app's credential read access: Storage Object Viewer on that bucket, and in Play Console the permission to view app information and download bulk reports (read-only). Google does not say whether both are needed, so use the test.
playSetup.step3: Paste it as the bucket of this app. Apps of another Play account get their own.
playSetup.step4: Optional, for estimated sales (what buyers paid, not your proceeds), monthly earnings (net of Google's fees and taxes) and subscription statistics: in Play Console, Users and permissions, give the service account View financial data, set to Global. These files are in the same bucket.
